_scenario.title: Mission control just started
_scenario.description: The server started a second ago: only the first fast poll has run, so the snapshot holds just the bitcube TCP check (online). The seasons, modal and probe keys don't exist yet (they appear after their first poll: within 5 s, 30 s and up to a minute). No stills yet.

expect.headline: Checking… bitcube answers; everything else is not known yet
expect.action: Wait a minute. Nothing is wrong yet, and nothing is known to be right either.
